w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Spool is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Chorus Line, Big Loud, Nevermore, Spool) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Buffering: Stand still. It aims where you will be. Give it nothing to predict and it whiffs. (Sanne lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
